value.rationale: The motivating theorem has a genuine endpoint gap between necessary and sufficient joint oscillation exponents. The diagonal result shows that this gap vanishes exactly in the natural one-symbol specialization, so the obstruction is genuinely caused by interaction between distinct symbols rather than roughness of the kernel. It also yields a complete complex-symbol BMO characterization for the natural second-order rough bilinear commutator norms.
